Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

The camera pans across a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all stands 127-year-old MANUEL, beaming with pride. He is presented with a certificate and a trophy, and the crowd erupts in applause.

**MANUEL**
(overcome with emotion)
This Is The Most Incredible Honor I Could Ever Ask For!

The camera zooms in on Manuel's face as he holds up the certificate, a wide smile spreading across his weathered features.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. MANUEL'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Manuel lies in bed, the certificate and trophy proudly displayed on his nightstand. He gazes at the certificate, a faraway look in his eyes.

**MANUEL (V.O.)**
I Remember Reading About This Theory On The Internet When I Was Young. Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Were Born, You Would Definitely Survive To The End Of Your Life. No Matter What Happened.

Manuel's eyes glaze over as he becomes lost in thought.

**MANUEL (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
I Never Thought Much Of It At The Time. But Now, As I Lie Here, Holding This Certificate, I Wonder... What If It's True?

Manuel's expression changes, his eyes taking on a manic quality.

**MANUEL (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
What If I'm Not Just A Record Holder? What If I'm The Only One Who's Ever Lived?

The camera zooms in on Manuel's face as he begins to sweat, his eyes darting back and forth.

**MANUEL (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
I'm The Only One Who's Ever Lived. I'm The Only One Who's Ever Survived. What If I'm The Only One Who's Ever Been Born?

Manuel's voice rises to a fever pitch as he becomes consumed by his own paranoia.

**MANUEL (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
What If I'm Not Even Real? What If I'm Just A Simulation? A Quantum Simulation?

The camera zooms out as Manuel's body begins to shake, his eyes rolling back in his head.

**MANUEL (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S EVER LIVED. I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S EVER SURVIVED. I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO'S EVER BEEN BORN.

The camera lingers on Manuel's face as he descends into madness, the sound of his own voice echoing in the darkness.

**FADE TO BLACK.**
